## What changes and why

## Checklist (faisal-security-lab)

- [ ] `make test` and `make acceptance` pass.
- [ ] No new dependency: the platform still imports only Python's standard library.
- [ ] No real secrets or personal data, in code, tests, logs or screenshots.
- [ ] The change stays inside the defensive scope (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] A scan can still only run through both authorization checks.
- [ ] Documentation that describes the changed behaviour is updated.
- [ ] Console texts are added in Arabic and in English.
- [ ] `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` is updated if a tool was added or its version changed.
